calls.title: GrowthBook<>The Wellness Company - POC Planning Call
calls.summary: GrowthBook was proposed as an in-house alternative to the current agency-run A/B testing (using GrowthBook via a third party), with features like GA4 integration, Snowflake compatibility, and traffic splitting. Key pain points included slow agency throughput (~2 tests/month), lack of data control, and delayed support; the customer (The Wellness Company) aims to increase to 10 tests/month. Next steps include setting up a cloud trial with a live traffic split test,
